assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under CARC code CO-97.
The CO-97 denial is a bundling denial (payment bundled into another covered procedure, so separate reimbursement is not permitted).
The service at issue is CPT 93271.
The indication note documents a patient with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation corresponds to diagnosis code I48.0.
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope.
Syncope corresponds to diagnosis code R55.
The episodes are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring.
The note states cardiac event monitoring is indicated for extended rhythm assessment.
The purpose is to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and determine the etiology of the collapse.
The extended rhythm assessment addresses a distinct clinical question documented in the indication note.
Separate reimbursement of CPT 93271 is warranted rather than bundling under CO-97.
The outstanding balance for this service is 357.79.
